g.text: LLD — Correctness contracts and capacity assumptions
PROPOSED · pin artifact versions; distinguish issuer data from customer ownership. Numerical examples are calculations, not measured capacity.
12 logical shards TOTAL; RF 2 => 24 shard replicas.
Issuer filters narrow candidates; queries may fan out.
Custom shard_number would be PER KEY. Avoid 8k keys.
AAPL · resolve alias by effective date
v17 · pin approved manifest for this run
Stage all chunks; reconcile deletions; validate visible counts; promote active release.
Pin parser / chunker / embedding versions. Keep prior release for rollback.
40M x 1024 x 2 bytes 81.92 GB fp16 originals
40M x 1024 x 1 byte 40.96 GB int8 copy
ADD: HNSW + sparse + payload indexes + page cache,
shard/segment overhead, WAL, optimizer + recovery reserve.
No final node count follows from vector bytes alone.
Measure resident memory + disk IOPS on a real sample.
Change one retrieval axis per paired frozen-fixture comparison.
Approve compression only within a declared loss margin and paired CI.
RETRIEVAL MEASUREMENT PATH · 300 ms p95 is a candidate objective, not a result
log wall time and query fan-out
measure whole path; p95s do not add
CACHE CONTRACTS · fingerprint the computation; never approximate snapshot identity
SEC evidence CIK + accession + parser + content hash immutable
News / market evidence source + query identity + fetched payload hash source TTL
Chunk embedding content hash + model revision + dims + preprocess immutable
Query embedding exact text hash + embedding fingerprint bounded TTL
Retrieval packets query + filters + index_release + retrieval_config release
Memo exact snapshot + request + prompt + model/settings snapshot
Verification decision memo hash + verifier version + output policy policy version
Quote used in memo is immutable. A refreshed live quote is a separate display.
Coalesce identical misses; log hit/miss and cold/warm tests, not promised hit bands.
Customer-scoped private data; issuer CIK filtering is not customer authorization.
A changed quote changes snapshot_hash. Never reuse a 15-minute bucket as the evidence identity.
Source TTL controls fetch reuse; immutable payload hashes control replay and memo provenance.
primary → independently qualified fallback; optional third model only with cost / recovery evidence.
Old memo eligible? preserve old snapshot + maximum age + degraded status. Otherwise typed failure.
Enforce customer admission and total attempt deadline; a snapshot alone does not guarantee an answer.
STATUS MACHINE · durable events; default stream contains progress until final policy + verification
required evidence class absent (guard, never a warning)
completed = final bytes verified + policy approved + required evidence present. Persist result + terminal event atomically.
GET events replays after Last-Event-ID; stale worker commits rejected by attempt fence. Optional provisional text stays unverified.
DURABLE BOUNDARIES · behavioral contracts, not identical model output
claim job: short SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED txn
increment attempt, set lease_until; release row lock
commit result: WHERE attempt = lease_attempt AND running
final memo + terminal event in one transaction
optional Streams: job + outbox txn; ACK after durable commit
jobs: crash + reclaim + stale worker; no duplicate terminal commit
models: quality / policy / refusal gates for each model revision
caches: changed dependency => miss; exact evidence survives replay
retrieval: matched filters + frozen-fixture paired quality comparison
